subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared group-pairing admission contract, and should pending read-only observation be included in that contract or split into a separate mode?
rationale: This changes authorization, durable approval state, owner notification routing, and whether untrusted shared-room content may reach an agent before approval, which cannot be safely chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Design shared admission first
options.body: Create a cross-channel group admission design, then implement Telegram/WhatsApp against that contract with explicit security and persistence rules.

options.title: Ship channel-specific mitigations only
options.body: Let narrower Telegram and WhatsApp warn/leave work proceed, but leave owner-notified cross-channel pairing for a later design.

options.title: Keep existing allowlist model
options.body: Reject group pairing for now and document allowlists, groupPolicy disabled, and sandboxed group sessions as the supported posture.

recommendation.title: Design shared admission first
recommendation.body: Create a cross-channel group admission design, then implement Telegram/WhatsApp against that contract with explicit security and persistence rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context and nearby config/security history make this the best available routing owner for deciding the product/security boundary.
